subject: history
title: Cold War & End of Empire Adventure
welcome_lead: After 1945, the world split in two and Britain's empire faded fast. Let's explore the Cold War and decolonisation. 🌐
meta_desc: Cold War Adventure — a KS3 History walkthrough of the Cold War, the end of empire and modern Britain.
final_note: You met the Cold War divide, the end of the British Empire, and the start of modern Britain.

walkthroughs.body_html:
After WW2 the world had two superpowers: the USA (capitalist) and the USSR (communist).

They never went to direct war, but stockpiled nuclear weapons, spied on each other and supported opposite sides in smaller wars. This is the Cold War.

Europe was split by an Iron Curtain: free West vs communist East. Britain stood with the USA in NATO from 1949. ☢️

After WW2, Britain was almost bankrupt and could not hold its empire.

India and Pakistan became independent in 1947. Through the 1950s and 60s, many African and Caribbean countries followed.

This is called decolonisation. People from new Commonwealth countries also moved to Britain — for example, the Windrush generation arrived from the Caribbean from 1948.

At home, Britain rebuilt itself with big new welfare programmes.

The National Health Service (NHS) opened in 1948, giving free healthcare to everyone. Many homes were built to replace bomb-damaged streets.

The Cold War ended when the Berlin Wall came down in 1989 and the USSR collapsed in 1991. Britain entered the 21st century as a modern, multicultural country. 🌍

mcqs.q: When did the National Health Service start?
What was the Elizabethan Religious Settlement of 1559?
options: A deliberate via media — a Protestant doctrine and English-language prayer book combined with some Catholic-style ceremony — designed to maximise conformity.
The Truman Doctrine ordered the dropping of the atomic bomb on Japan.
Elizabeth made England fully Protestant and banned Catholic worship outright.
Elizabeth reunited England with the Pope to make peace with Spain.

mcqs.q: What did the Truman Doctrine commit the US to in 1947?
options: Elizabeth reunited England with the Pope to make peace with Spain.
Supporting free peoples resisting communist takeover — initially Greece and Turkey — formalising the policy of containment articulated by George Kennan.
The Truman Doctrine declared war on the Soviet Union.
The Truman Doctrine ordered the dropping of the atomic bomb on Japan.

mcqs.q: What did Magna Carta actually do in 1215?
options: The Truman Doctrine ordered the dropping of the atomic bomb on Japan.
Magna Carta abolished the monarchy and created Parliament.
Magna Carta gave ordinary English people democratic rights and freedom.
It was a peace treaty between King John and rebel barons protecting baronial privileges and limiting arbitrary royal taxation and imprisonment — it was annulled within months.
